title: Hybrid score aggregator for cross-task validation of FP8/INT8 quantized variants
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a modular "hybrid score aggregator" to produce single composite quality signals for FP8/INT8 quantized model variants across diverse tasks. This ticket implements normalization, per-task weighting, and calibration-aware adjustments so that downstream rollouts (canary/A-B) and quality gate automation can make consistent decisions across generation, classification, and retrieval tasks. The aggregator will ingest task-level scorers (perplexity, MMLU accuracy, BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, and custom task scorers such as SQuAD F1 and code-execution success rate) and emit: normalized metric vectors, a composite quality index, and per-metric deltas vs baseline. It will also integrate with calibration runs to apply bias corrections for INT8/FP8 variants (prefix-aware perplexity correction, tokenization alignment), and expose confidence bands for small-sample evaluations.
acceptance_criteria: Aggregator ingests outputs from existing eval pipelines for at least 6 tasks: token-lm perplexity, MMLU, SQuAD, summarization (ROUGE), translation (BLEU), codegen (execution pass@1)
Per-metric normalization implemented (z-score and rank-based) with configurable method per metric
Composite quality index computed via configurable weights and produces same-sign improvement/decline readable by rollout tooling
Calibration-aware adjustments available as opt-in: bias offset and slope correction derived from calibration jobs
End-to-end latency for scoring a standard eval bundle (10k examples across tasks) < 20 minutes on CI runners with caching enabled
Integration hooks added: console dashboard (runtime-1.24), CI check that blocks canary rollouts when composite index declines by >1.5 sigma
Unit tests covering normalization, weighting, and calibration transforms with synthetic distributions
tasks: Define metric schema and normalization primitives (zscore, min-max, rank)
Implement plugin interface for task-specific scorers (python adapters)
Add calibration-aware transform module: compute offset/slope from calibration histogram artifacts
Wire aggregator into eval pipeline and CI (hook into ENG-5372 pipeline outputs)
Create lightweight job to produce small-sample confidence bands using bootstrap sampling
Expose REST endpoint and local CLI to produce JSON reports consumed by Console and rollout automation
Add Grafana panel and Dataset page in Console for composite index and per-metric deltas
notes: Decisions: Use z-score by default for cross-metric comparability but allow project-specific rank transforms when tails are heavy
Trade-offs: Z-score preserves magnitude information but is sensitive to non-normal distributions; bootstrap-based CIs mitigate some risk
Cost considerations: Running full eval suites for every commit is expensive. We will cache raw model outputs and only recompute scorers when code or model weights change
Fallback policy: If calibration artifacts are missing, aggregator will emit 'uncalibrated' flag and fall back to baseline metrics without correction
Security: Output reports will strip any raw prompts that contain PII before persisting to long-term storage
